title: Linear antibody epitope prediction using AlphaFold2.
authors: DeRoo, Jacob; Terry, James S; Zhao, Ning; Stasevich, Timothy J; Snow, Christopher; Geiss, Brian J
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于AlphaFold2的PAbFold流程，通过预测抗体-线性肽复合物结构来预测线性抗体表位，属于蛋白质结构预测在抗体表位识别上的应用，方法创新且经实验验证。
abstract: Defining the binding epitopes of antibodies is essential for understanding how they bind to their antigens and perform their molecular functions. However, while determining linear epitopes of monoclonal antibodies can be accomplished utilizing well-established empirical procedures, these approaches are generally labor- and time-intensive, and costly. To take advantage of the recent advances in protein structure prediction algorithms available to the scientific community, we developed a calculation pipeline based on the localColabFold implementation of AlphaFold2 that can predict linear antibody epitopes by predicting the structure of the complex between antibody heavy and light chains and target peptide sequences derived from antigens. We found that this AlphaFold2 pipeline, which we call PAbFold, was able to accurately flag known epitope sequences for several well-known antibody targets (HA/Myc) when the target sequence was broken into small overlapping linear peptides and antibody complementarity determining regions were grafted onto several different antibody framework regions in the single-chain antibody fragment format. To determine if this pipeline was able to identify the epitope of a novel antibody with no structural information publicly available, we determined the epitope of a novel anti-SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid-targeted antibody using our method and then experimentally validated our computational results using peptide competition ELISA assays. These results indicate that the AlphaFold2-based PAbFold pipeline we developed is capable of accurately identifying linear antibody epitopes in a short time using just antibody and target protein sequences. This emergent capability of the method is sensitive to methodological details such as peptide length, AlphaFold2 neural network versions, and multiple-sequence alignment databases. PAbFold is available at https://github.com/jbderoo/PAbFold.
abstract_zh: 定义抗体的结合表位对于理解其如何与抗原结合并执行分子功能至关重要。然而，虽然利用成熟的经验性程序可以完成单克隆抗体线性表位的测定，但这些方法通常劳动密集、耗时且成本高昂。为了利用科学界可用的蛋白质结构预测算法的最新进展，我们开发了一个基于AlphaFold2的localColabFold实现的计算流程，通过预测抗体重链和轻链与源自抗原的靶标肽段序列之间的复合物结构，来预测线性抗体表位。我们发现，这个我们称为PAbFold的AlphaFold2流程，在将靶标序列分解为小的重叠线性肽段，并将抗体互补决定区移植到单链抗体片段格式中的几种不同抗体框架区上时，能够准确标记多个已知抗体靶标（HA/Myc）的已知表位序列。为了确定该流程是否能识别出无公开结构信息的新型抗体的表位，我们使用我们的方法确定了一种新型抗SARS-CoV-2核衣壳靶向抗体的表位，并通过肽竞争ELISA实验验证了我们的计算结果。这些结果表明，我们开发的基于AlphaFold2的PAbFold流程能够仅使用抗体和靶蛋白序列，在短时间内准确识别线性抗体表位。该方法的这种新兴能力对方法学细节敏感，如肽段长度、AlphaFold2神经网络版本和多序列比对数据库。PAbFold可在https://github.com/jbderoo/PAbFold获取。
